markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (76%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review

Input is flagged (OOD 100th percentile) [F6], the set holds two classes, and the second model disagrees.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Benign 76%, InSitu 22%, Normal 1%, Invasive <1% | Benign leads; in situ possible |
| Conformal set | Benign, InSitu (90%) [F1] | Cannot separate the two |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.77 / 100th percentile, flagged | Input looks atypical |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | No | Models pick different classes |
| Similar cases | 2 of 5 Benign [F5] | Weak neighbor support |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 1) · ↑ invasive · Score well below typical; lowers invasive likelihood [F2] · Validated
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 4) · ↑ invasive · Typical level; concept model adds invasive weight, counterintuitively [F4] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Above-typical score; leans away from invasive · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 5) · context · Typical score; bears on in situ alternative · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Deletion CI excludes 0 (+0.54 logit, 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier's invasive logit.
- **Concepts**: Deletion CI includes 0 (+0.002, −0.005 to 0.007); not shown to reflect the classifier. Normal lobules (0/20) is Unreliable but gives the largest positive term [F3].

## Could be wrong if
- Degraded resample input (OOD 100th percentile) may distort every score, including probabilities.
- Second model disagrees and only 2 of 5 neighbors are Benign; in situ cannot be excluded.

## Check on the slide
1. **Region 5** — look for atypical cells confined within ducts (in situ versus benign).
2. **Region 1** — confirm stroma shows no tumor infiltration.
3. **Regions 3, 9** — check gland formation and nuclear atypia against the benign call.
